items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Dick Allen; Dick Allen is identified only as the interviewer.

ctx.x: Yeah, and uh, maybe we should all put our names down here. We have a guest, special guest from Sweden. Yeah. Hans Lekut. And I'm Dick Allen. That way everybody will know who's on the tape if they'll listen to it. Yeah. Well, tell us about yourself, where you were born and all that.
Well, I was born in all of the Turbone Parish. Turbone Parish. Turbone Parish. That's in Louisiana. Or, it's in home. Home Louisiana, but it's in the parish of Turbone.
